summary: Honda Motor Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K as a foreign private issuer to respond to a media report about its expected consolidated operating loss. The filing states that the company has not made any announcement regarding the reported loss, and that the actual consolidated operating loss for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2026, is expected to fall within the range of the previously announced forecast, which will be confirmed and announced on May 14, 2026. This is a routine correction of a media rumor and does not constitute a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special event.
